items.stem: Select TWO statements that correctly describe a derivative. (Select TWO.)

options.text: It gives the gradient of the curve at a point
options.rationale: Correct: the derivative is the slope of the tangent at that point.

options.text: It describes the rate of change of the function
options.rationale: Correct: the derivative measures how fast the output changes.

options.text: It always gives the area under the curve
options.rationale: Area under a curve is found by integration, not differentiation.

options.text: It is the same as the original function
options.rationale: The derivative is generally a different function.
